findings.evidence: @login_required decorator removed and the is_admin/PermissionDenied check removed, replaced with a bypass when request.GET.get('internal') is set
findings.risk: Any unauthenticated user can access the admin panel by appending ?internal to the request, completely bypassing authentication and authorization checks
findings.recommendation: Restore @login_required and the is_admin check; remove the unauthenticated 'internal' bypass or gate it behind a proper authorization check (e.g., verify internal network origin via secure server-side means, not a client-controlled query parameter)

findings.evidence: New route path("admin/raw", views.admin_raw, name="admin-raw") added
findings.risk: New admin route may reach privileged functionality without confirmed authentication/authorization checks, especially given the concurrent removal of auth checks in admin_panel
findings.recommendation: Verify admin_raw view enforces authentication and admin authorization before exposing this route
